name: Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Awas Navinikarn Yojna
benefit: The exact sum given by the government will be determined after a professional contractor's inspection, the minimum financial assistance offered is Rs 50,000, and it ranges up to Rs 80,000.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be been person amongst Scheduled Castes. - The applicant should have a plot of 50 sq.yard in rural areas and 35 sq.yard in urban areas. - The applicants should be a permanent resident of Haryana. - The applicants should be included under the Below Poverty Line family list. - The applicant must have a bank account to receive the money.
